answer: Reaching eligibility takes 59 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The knoll register is checked at draw time, tundra lists the eligible set, and basalt seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 59 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 134 account operation therefore ties up 21 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
